name: Robert Taft Jr.
summary: Robert Alphonso Taft Jr. (February 26, 1917 – December 7, 1993) was an American politician who served as a United States Senator from Ohio from 1971 to 1976. A member of the Republican Party, he also served in the United States House of Representatives from 1963 and 1965, and again from 1967 to 1971.
